basics.name: Vishakh P Kumar
basics.tagline: Result-oriented engineer with 6+ years of experience in building scalable systems and modern web applications.

paragraphs: I am a result-oriented professional targeting software engineering assignments with leading organizations.
I work as part of scrum teams in fully agile projects and have been involved in transitioning legacy AngularJS and .NET systems into modern microservices and microfrontends with .NET Core and React.
I contribute across software design, implementation, functional validation, and peer code reviews while mentoring junior developers and interns.

experience.title: Software Engineer II
bullets: Working with leading clients in the Payment Processing and Risk Management domains.
Heading AI driven development initiatives to build scalable and efficient solutions.

experience.title: Module Lead
bullets: Participate in design discussions and code reviews, integrating and validating new product designs.
Research, design, and implement scalable applications for information extraction and retrieval workflows.
Support migration of legacy systems to modern .NET Core and React-driven architectures.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Contributed to end-to-end projects from requirement gathering through production deployment.
Built software using React, Angular, and .NET with focus on design verification and functional testing.
Worked on software design and implementation for embedded and production-grade systems.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Contributed to full lifecycle delivery for financial services institutions.
Supported senior management with product direction and design decisions on critical modules.
Analyzed defects and proposed feasible technical solutions through requirement and problem analysis.
